records.title: AI Model Security and Monitoring Policy
records.review_cycle: Semi-annual and on material model or regulatory change

sections.heading: purpose
sections.summary: Management-approved requirements for secure operation, monitoring and oversight of the fine-tuned customer service LLM.

sections.heading: scope
sections.summary: Inference endpoint, administration interface, weights, prompts and guardrails, fine-tuning artifacts, inference-time customer data, API layer, logging and rollback; non-production instances using production-derived data.

sections.heading: policy_statements
sections.summary: Least-privilege access to endpoint, administration, weights, prompts and fine-tuning data; quarterly certification; revocation within 24 hours.

sections.heading: policy_statements
sections.summary: Continuous automated monitoring; weekly documented output review; critical alerts triaged within 15 minutes; a 5-point accuracy drop, confirmed disclosure or control-bypassing prompt injection triggers formal review.

sections.heading: policy_statements
sections.summary: Defined AI security incident classes; Severity 1 acknowledged within 15 minutes and CISO, Model Owner and AI Governance Lead notified within one hour.

sections.heading: policy_statements
sections.summary: Retraining, version, prompt, guardrail and pipeline changes need impact assessment, security testing, validation, approval and a tested rollback path.

sections.heading: policy_statements
sections.summary: Minimum necessary customer data at inference, approved data paths only; confirmed disclosure handled as an AI security incident.

sections.heading: roles
sections.summary: Model Owner, Security Operations, Data Steward, System Administrator, AI Governance Lead and Incident Response Lead with named obligations.

sections.heading: assumptions
sections.summary: Clause-to-Annex pairings follow the organization's reference guide and are pending verification against the licensed standard.

unresolved_assumptions: Enforcement section not yet reviewed by Legal

records.title: Restricted access, data protection and retention
records.summary: Least-privilege gateway access for approved Compliance and Legal groups; encryption in transit and at rest; scheduled purge of session data and retained documents; no scope expansion without governance approval.
metrics: 100% production access through approved gateway roles
Monthly evidence of retention and disposal jobs

records.title: Continuous monitoring, performance review and human oversight
records.summary: Continuous logging and monitoring of prompts, outputs, access events, anomalies and performance; weekly governance review; material anomalies and consequential outputs trigger documented human review and escalation.
metrics: Human review evidence for consequential outputs

records.title: AI security incident classification and response
records.summary: Prompt injection, unauthorized access, weight modification, sensitive disclosure and sustained anomalous behaviour are AI security incidents with named owner, containment, evidence, root cause and closure approval.
metrics: Incidents registered within one business day
100% with owner, containment, evidence, root cause and closure approval
